integrity: Universal proof is by explicit free-face pairs and lattice translation quotients. Finite computations independently check examples but are not an infinite certificate. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The period lattice must have no nonzero vector of L1 norm below five. The original neighborhood complex collapses to, but is not itself asserted PL-homeomorphic to, the torus core. Some cyclic specializations are already treated in earlier work; possible unindexed equivalent formulations remain an originality risk.
title: Toroidal grid neighborhood complexes collapse to one or two tori
